findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key appended as a query parameter (?api_key=IVY26-...)
findings.actual: Query parameter is rejected with 401. Key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Probed GET /v1/listings with api_key query param; received error: 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'.
findings.impact: All requests failed authentication until moved to X-API-Key header.

findings.documented: Collection endpoints only describe carrying the API key.
findings.actual: Returns 401 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first'. Authorization header with Bearer token is strictly required.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/listings with only X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: Anonymous browsing of collections is impossible; user session must be initiated first.

findings.documented: Returns { token, expires_in: 86400 } valid for 24 hours with no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns access_token and refresh_token. expires_in is 900 seconds (15 minutes). A dedicated /auth/refresh endpoint exists.
findings.how_found: Logged in at POST /auth/login and inspected response payload and expiration timestamp.
findings.impact: Without a background token refresh daemon, any user session dies after 15 minutes of activity.

findings.documented: Takes 1-indexed page parameter to paginate records (page=1, page=2).
findings.actual: page parameter is quietly ignored; requests with page=1 and page=2 return identical listings. Pagination requires offset parameter.
findings.how_found: Compared record IDs from /v1/listings?page=1&limit=5 and /v1/listings?page=2&limit=5; found identical arrays.
findings.impact: Pagination in clients using page would loop infinitely on the first page.

findings.documented: Parameter limit has default 20 and maximum 200.
findings.actual: Any limit requested above 50 (e.g. 100, 200) is silently clamped to 50 records per page.
findings.how_found: Requested limit=100 and limit=200; server response returned limit: 50 and count: 50.
findings.impact: Clients requesting 200 records per page fetch only 25% of expected records.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters. Read total, divide by limit, and request that many pages.
findings.actual: total is reported as 4925, but 5,100 records are retrievable when paging with offset until has_more is false.
findings.how_found: Continued paging beyond offset=4925 and received valid records up to offset=5050.
findings.impact: Clients relying on total/limit to determine page count miss the final 175 records.

findings.documented: Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side, so anything returned is safe to show.
findings.actual: Returns 1,083 listing records where is_live is false.
findings.how_found: Inspected is_live boolean distribution across the 5,100 retrieved records.
findings.impact: Clients must filter is_live client-side to avoid showing withdrawn homes to buyers.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listings across different portals describe the identical physical property (same apartment, bedroom, floor, coordinates, and area).
findings.how_found: Clustered records by (locality, apartment_name, bedroom, floor, total_floors); found 4,704 distinct properties across 5,100 listings.
findings.impact: Users see identical properties repeated across different portal source tags.

findings.documented: Singular GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} fetches a single listing.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. The actual working endpoint is plural: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listing/SQU-5004678 -> 404; GET /v1/listings/SQU-5004678 -> 200.
findings.impact: Detail view failed until route was updated to plural /v1/listings/{id}.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. Endpoint was planned but never implemented.
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings/SQU-5004678/similar; received 404 Not Found.
findings.impact: Comparable listings must be calculated dynamically client-side.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for your city.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found under both authenticated and unauthenticated requests.
findings.how_found: Tested /v1/analytics/summary, /v1/analytics, /analytics/summary; all 404.
findings.impact: City metrics and analytics must be computed client-side from the raw dataset.

findings.documented: GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites with { 'id': '...' }, DELETE /v1/favourites/{id}.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. Real endpoint is /v1/saved, requiring POST body { 'listing_id': '...' } and DELETE /v1/saved/{listing_id}.
findings.how_found: Probed route variants; /v1/favourites 404, /v1/saved returned 200. POST with 'id' gave 422 validation error demanding 'listing_id'.
findings.impact: Saved listings feature fails completely if using the documented paths and schema.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees (integers).
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are floating-point values denominated in Crores (e.g. 12.44 = ₹12.44 Cr = ₹124,400,000 INR).
findings.how_found: Compared project price_min/price_max values against actual listing prices in the same projects.
findings.impact: Showing project prices directly as rupees would display luxury projects for ₹4 to ₹12.

findings.documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listings from MagicHomes (website: magichomes) report carpet_area in square meters for values < 300 (e.g. 78 sqm).
findings.how_found: Identified 455 MagicHomes records with carpet_area < 300. Multiplying by 10.7639 aligns exactly with standard 2-4 BHK square footage.
findings.impact: Uncorrected sqm values double the apparent price-per-sqft from ₹32,504 to ₹63,758.

findings.documented: Timestamps: ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listings posted_at timestamps omit the Z suffix and timezone offset (e.g. '2026-06-21T16:40:00'), whereas rentals have Z and health has +05:30.
findings.how_found: Inspected sample records across collections; listings timestamps lack timezone indicator.
findings.impact: Datetime parsers default to local system time unless explicitly parsed.

findings.documented: Takes order parameter: 'asc' (default) or 'desc'.
findings.actual: order parameter is quietly ignored by /v1/listings; sort_by=price&order=desc returns prices in ascending order.
findings.how_found: Requested sort_by=price&order=desc; results returned negative prices first (-₹64.6M, -₹49.9M).
findings.impact: Server-side descending sort is broken; sorting must be performed client-side.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings?project_id=... filters listings by builder project.
findings.actual: project_id query parameter is quietly ignored by the server, returning unfiltered city listings.
findings.how_found: Queried /v1/listings?project_id=P50001; server returned total: 4925 with listings from diverse projects.
findings.impact: Clients must filter project listings client-side.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with available listings.
findings.actual: For 166 projects, total_listings contradicts the count of active live listings associated with that project_id.
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced project total_listings against actual live listings in listings dataset.
findings.impact: Displayed project listing counts are out of sync with actual inventory.

findings.documented: Honest and healthy listing inventory.
findings.actual: Contains 44 corrupt records describing physical impossibilities (11 floor > total_floors, 11 carpet > super built-up, 11 negative prices, 11 swapped coordinates).
findings.how_found: Systematic domain boundary validation across all numeric and coordinate fields.
findings.impact: Renders impossible specs and corrupts market averages unless filtered.

findings.documented: Sellers and verified broker listings.
findings.actual: 190 fake enquiry-bait listings operated across 5 syndicate phone numbers with rotating aliases and ~50% below-market prices soliciting advance tokens.
findings.how_found: Clustered high-frequency phone numbers, identified identical token-solicitation text, and verified ~0.52 price ratio against peer units.
findings.impact: Presents severe fraud risk to home buyers seeking genuine units.
